Count the grapes: red ones, roughly 12, plus 1 green, so about 13 grapes. There is also a tiny orange bit, possibly carrot, and some crumbs.

Each grape is about 5 g, so 13 grapes come to about 65 g. Adding about 2 g for the other bits gives roughly 67 g total.

Grapes are about 0.69 kcal/g, so 65 g is about 45 kcal. The extras add about 1 kcal, for a total near 46 kcal.
